title: Diff Auditor team config
description: Team defaults for the Agent Diff Auditor extension and the diffaudit CLI. Commit this file at the repository root.

ignoreRules.description: Rule ids to switch off for everyone on the team.

minSeverity.description: Hide findings below this severity. A value set in VS Code settings or with --min-severity wins.

ignorePaths.description: Files left out of the audit, as gitignore-style globs relative to the repository root, for example "legacy/**" or "**/*.generated.ts".

baseRef.description: Ref to compare the working tree against, for example origin/main. A value set in VS Code settings or with --base wins.
